# Karmathy HCM — Synthetic Seed Data

**Generated by:** `seed/dev/seed_dev.py`
**Command:** `make seed-demo` (or `SECRET_KEY=... DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./seed_dev.db python -m seed.dev.seed_dev`)
**Iteration:** 0
**Date:** 2026-10-20

## Purpose

Provides deterministic, reproducible synthetic data so features can be seen,
tested, and validated without any real personal data. All names, emails,
salaries, and IDs are fictional.

## Safety

- **Refuses production targets.** The seed aborts if `DATABASE_URL` points at
  Oracle or any non-localhost host. See `seed/dev/seed_dev.py::_is_production_target`.
- **No credentials in output.** Account passwords are written only to
  `seed/dev/.credentials.out` (mode `0600`, git-ignored). They are never
  printed to stdout or committed.
- **Idempotent.** Re-running the seed detects existing users and skips. To
  reseed from scratch: `make seed-reset`.

## Tenants

Two tenants are generated in one database, distinguished by code prefixes:

| Tenant | Key | Currency | Timezone | Departments | Locations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BrightMart Retail | `retail` | USD | America/New_York | 6 | 4 |
| SkyLine Construction | `construction` | CAD | America/Toronto | 6 | 4 |

Each tenant has:
- 6 departments (e.g. Store Operations, Project Management)
- 4 locations with timezones
- 10 jobs with salary bands
- 300 employees (~400 active across both tenants after status mix)

| Table | Count | Notes |

| jobs | 20 | 10 per tenant |

| leave_requests | 788 | 1–3 per active employee over 2 years |

## Generated accounts

One SuperAdmin, one HR Admin, two Managers, one PayrollViewer, and five
Associates per tenant (20 total). Credentials are generated at seed time and
written to `seed/dev/.credentials.out`.

| Tenant | Roles |
|---|---|
| retail | SuperAdmin, HR Admin, Manager ×2, PayrollViewer, Associate ×5 |
| construction | SuperAdmin, HR Admin, Manager ×2, PayrollViewer, Associate ×5 |

The SuperAdmin account is created with `must_change_password=true` and can only
reach `/auth/me`, `/auth/password`, and `/auth/logout` until a new password is
set.

## Leave data

- Leave types: Annual, Sick, Casual, Maternity, Paternity, Bereavement
- Balances: current and previous year, Annual Leave only
- Requests: 1–3 per active employee over 2 years, statuses distributed across
  Approved / Pending / Rejected / Cancelled
- Approved/rejected requests have a decider (Manager) and decision timestamp

## Time data

- 12 weeks of clock-in/clock-out records
- Weekdays only, ~90% show rate
- Realistic variation: clock-in 08:00–10:00, clock-out 17:00–19:00
- Overtime calculated for days over 8 hours
- All entries sourced from "Web", status "Approved"

## What is NOT in the seed (intentionally)

| Area | Reason |
|---|---|
| Payroll runs | Payroll is blocked without a verified India rule pack (Gate 0 decision). Seed loads the blocked state only. |
| Scheduling rosters | Requires the roster solver (Block 4). |
| Forecast drivers | Requires the forecasting engine (Block 4). |
| Recruiting / performance | Requires those modules (Block 6). |
| Compliance records | Requires retention/erasure tooling (Block 5). |
| Import fixtures | CSV templates live in `tests/fixtures/imports/` (separate from seed). |

## Reseding

```bash
make seed-reset
```

This deletes `seed_dev.db` and regenerates from scratch with identical results
(fixed random seed `424242`).
